Chief Complaint:
Patient presents with dyspnea and fever for 3 days.

Subjective:
55-year-old male reports progressive shortness of breath, productive cough, and
subjective fevers starting three days ago. Denies chest pain. Reports mild fatigue.

Objective:
Temp 38.9C, HR 102, RR 22, SpO2 94% on room air. Crackles heard at right lung base
on auscultation. Chest X-ray shows right lower lobe consolidation.

Assessment:
Findings consistent with community-acquired pneumonia.

Plan:
Start amoxicillin 500mg three times daily for 7 days. Recheck in 48 hours if
symptoms do not improve. Advise rest and fluids.
